(2021) Behav Res Methods 53:2302-2325, doi:10.3758/s13428-021-01573-x (PMC8641698); instructions from its ESM appendix static-content.springer.com/esm/art%3A10.3758%2Fs13428-021-01573-x/MediaObjects/13428_2021_1573_MOESM2_ESM.pdf; processing script data/mturk_ddm.R
note: mapping_basis=data_labels in its strongest form: the IRW item code is not a label for the stimulus, it IS the stimulus. data/mturk_ddm.R sets item <- x$test_word_string, column 11 of OSF za9y8's Experiment1.data ('the character string presented at test', per the deposit's own Experiment1.description). No positional or generated component, so core model section 3's first derivation pattern applies. Verified anyway by re-running the script over the raw file: 2202/2202 distinct words identical to the live item set, and per-item scored-trial n identical for all 2202 items (0 mismatches) against irw_table_sets() server-side aggregates. text_source=study_materials: `instructions` is transcribed verbatim from the READ-AND-GO memory-experiment block of the article's own instruction appendix (Springer ESM 13428_2021_1573_MOESM2_ESM.pdf = NIHMS1754126-supplement-Appendix_-_Instructions.pdf, appendix p.2), which is the wording participants read before the recognition task; the appendix's longer DETAILED INSTRUCTIONS screen and the pre-task 'This is a memory task' screen are the same task's other two instruction screens and were deliberately not concatenated in. The source's curly apostrophes and its literal '--' are kept as printed. item_text is the stimulus word itself, lowercase as in the source data file. resp is accuracy: 1 = correct, confirmed against the raw file (0/2202 per-item resp-range mismatches under this coding, 249/2202 under the flipped coding). correct_response blank -- studied/new status varies by trial, not by item. English administration, so no language/_translated columns. RIGHTS: the stimuli are ordinary English words drawn from Kucera & Francis frequency pools -- no instrument, no rights holder, and no clause reserving any right is locatable for either the word pools or the task instructions; the article's own copyright notice is a notice about the article (the PANAS case), not a term governing the wording. Silence is permission, so irw#1891/#1945 do not fire.
public_note: Item recognition memory task: item_text is the word that appeared on the test list (identical to the item code), resp is trial accuracy (1 = correct) rather than the yes/no key pressed, and correct_response is blank because whether a given word was studied or new was randomised per participant and block.

source_ref: OSF osf.io/za9y8 (Experiment2.data + Experiment2.description); Ratcliff & Hendrickson 2021, Behav Res 53:2302-2325, doi:10.3758/s13428-021-01573-x
note: Item code is paste(column_7_value, column_8_value) of the OSF deposit's Experiment2.data (task_number==2); the deposit's own Experiment2.description codebook defines column_7_value = number of dots and column_8_value = area flag (1 = summed dot area forced near the mean area of 25 dots, 2 = area unrestricted/proportional), and defines the response keys (key ID 1 = "number of dots greater than 25", 2 = "less than 25"), which is where correct_response comes from -- a published key, not one this project derived. instructions transcribed verbatim from the paper's Method (Ratcliff & Hendrickson 2021, Behav Res 53:2302-2325, p.2313): 'Subjects were instructed to press the "z" key if the number of dots was less than 25 and the "/" key if the number was greater than 25.' Left in the paper's third-person reported form rather than rewritten as an imperative, because that is the only form published; the on-screen wording is not in the paper or the deposit. item_text blank by design (dot-array stimuli, no wording) per the 2026-09-05 picture-stimulus ruling, following twod_rotation_mather2023. No rights restriction locatable: this is the authors' own laboratory perceptual task, not a published or commercially licensed instrument, and no fee, no-redistribution, non-commercial or permission clause is stated anywhere in the paper or the CC-licensed-free OSF deposit (osf.io/za9y8 carries no node_license). Mapping proved by re-running data/mturk_ddm.R over the raw deposit file: all 12 items reproduce live n exactly and live mean accuracy to 0.0e+00.
public_note: The Y25 task shows dot arrays, so there is no item wording: item_text is blank by design and each item code names its condition (number of dots, then area flag 1 = total dot area held near the area of 25 dots, 2 = area proportional to numerosity). resp is scored for accuracy, so option_text reads Correct/Incorrect rather than the keys pressed.

source_ref: OSF 9j6hm (Much, Mutak, Pohl & Ranger 2025, J Open Psychol Data 13(1), doi:10.5334/jopd.124): 1_Main data files/tte_codebook.csv, 2_Supplemental files/mr_itemsolutions.csv and mr_ItemOverview.pdf; instructions from the article Method section. Items are OMIB (Koch et al. 2022, https://osf.io/4km79/, GPLv3).
note: mapping_basis=data_labels: the deposit's tte_codebook.csv labels X_MR01_01/Y_MR01_01 as the raw and scored response to 'the first item' through to MR20, and mr_itemsolutions.csv is keyed by the literal codes MR01..MR20; data/much_tte_2025.R derives the IRW item code by a number-preserving strip of the X_/Y_ prefix and the _01/_02 block suffix, so there is no positional step. Checked anyway and it reproduces: scoring each participant's raw 20-bit selection string against the shipped key reproduces the authors' own 0/1 scoring for 24737/24737 non-missing responses (see verify_much_tte_2025_matrixreasoning.R). Instructions transcribed verbatim from the paper's Method section (both counterbalanced variants, labelled). correct_response is the published OMIB solution key (key_source would be source_published). No item_text shipped: figural stimuli, images only in mr_ItemOverview.pdf. option_text 'Incorrect'/'Correct' names the codebook's 0/1 'Scored response'; the source prints no anchor labels.
public_note: The speed/accuracy block instruction was counterbalanced across participants (Group 1 saw the non-speeded framing first, Group 2 the speeded), so the instructions field reproduces both verbatim rather than the one wording any single respondent read; item_text is blank because the OMIB matrix stimuli are figures, not text.
